headline: Iran says nuclear facilities targeted after Israel says attacks will escalate
summary: Iranian state media said its nuclear facilities were attacked on Friday, hours after Israel threatened to escalate its attacks. The reports point to a widening of the US-Israel and Iran war.
why: Iran is a major oil producer, and conflict involving it and the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil shipping route, is a central driver of global energy prices and risk sentiment.
why_moved: The report of attacks on Iranian nuclear sites, following Israeli threats to escalate, raises fears of a wider regional war and disruption to oil supply.
